specs.rationale: Accessible names, disabled state, keyboard reachability and control state depend on UI/runtime behavior, not real world bytes.
Touch reachability, drawers and focus restoration are viewport/UI oracles over representative deterministic data.
These assertions explicitly verify Oteryn-Game source authority, contract_id/capability metadata and real published records; a small immutable real export is sufficient.
Coordinate navigation, pan/zoom, controls and LOD transitions require deterministic topology through the production runtime only.
Mobile drawers and representation transitions are runtime/UI oracles independent of complete real content.
Exact Game-owned Sam/Rat/Sigurd/H.L. trade, loot, completeness, stats and large-shop facts require the bounded canonical real product.
Gameplay inspector activation, tab state, semantic round-trip, URL persistence and desktop surface geometry are UI/runtime oracles over representative fixture creatures.
Touch activation, drawer/tab reachability and topmost Escape behavior need representative fixture NPC/monster records rather than canonical Game facts.
Exact Game-owned Sam/Rat trade, loot, stats and presentation facts require the bounded canonical real product.
Cards, overlap choice, hit-testing, stale geometry invalidation, copy-link and reload need representative NPC/monster placements; historical real placement coordinates are not part of the oracle.
Touch creature activation, card/inspector behavior and geometry require representative deterministic placements only.
Dense occupancy, factual-role row layout, LOD, selection and animation lifecycle are presentation/runtime oracles; fixture records can encode the required role shapes.
DPR/label layout and AUTO detail/minimap representation need representative fixture badges and placements, not real complete-world bytes.
Filters, repaint, search deep links and bounded diagnostics are functional creature oracles; a fixture search record and creature placement are sufficient.
Search outage, malformed schema and degraded-state behavior require controlled positive/negative fixture variants.
Smoke qualification, authenticated range streaming, overview, zoom and semantic navigation need a valid production-format fixture; the historical Thais label is replaceable test data, not the oracle.
Farm UI fail-closed behavior, selected-monster flow, URL state and estimator semantics require a representative fixture monster, not canonical Cave Rat bytes.
Mobile Farm Explorer reachability and estimator interaction are functional UI contracts over representative fixture data.
This isolated oracle asserts the complete published animation programs product, its manifest digest and exact production-wide coverage census.
Base/creature synchronization, floor isolation, pan and deep-link restoration require multi-floor deterministic topology through real renderer seams.
Portrait/landscape resize geometry is a transform/synchronization oracle over representative topology.
Layer availability and fail-closed state use representative layer products and negative variants, not complete real data.
Mobile smoke, drawers and semantic navigation can use a deterministic search record; the historical Sam record is not part of the correctness claim.
The normalized workload measures bounded structural budgets; fixture density can be versioned to the workload without importing real-world identity.
Abort/reorder/back/reload races need controlled delayed authenticated ranges and deterministic state, which a fixture can reproduce exactly.
WebGL non-blank detail and committed-frame replacement require representative verified pixel content, not complete real pixels.
Corrupt ranges, missing optional inputs, malformed search and version mismatch are controlled loader/runtime failure oracles suited to fixture variants.
Responsive controls, backdrop, resize and optional creature controls are viewport/shell oracles independent of real world content.
The bounded search-corpus DOM-growth oracle can use a deliberately sized deterministic fixture corpus; production corpus identity/size is not asserted.
Repeated interaction structural-state retention is a runtime lifetime oracle and should use a replayable fixture rather than incidental real data.
URL/history/reload/invalid-coordinate behavior needs stable bounds and navigation state only.
Seeded interaction stress checks geometry/state invariants over replayable actions, not complete-world scale.
Cross-feature desktop journeys require representative search/map/creature/state data through the production runtime, not complete real bytes.
Touch-first cross-feature journeys require representative deterministic data only.
After the complete animation census split, the remaining oracles concern Atlas-owned chrome, transition isolation and functional playback pixels; rights-safe fixture pixels are sufficient.
Atlas-owned mobile chrome/drawer layout and functional toggles can be reviewed over rights-safe fixture data.
Semantic-result navigation, reload and history dynamically select an adequate record and do not require real complete-world identity.
